content:
I’m pleased to share that I have successfully participated in the webinar on “Beyond Biological Motherhood (Hamsaanandini Nanduri & the Right to Maternity Benefits),” organised by Legal Vidhya and held on 13th September 2026.

I’m grateful to Legal Vidhya for providing this valuable learning opportunity and for the insightful session on contemporary legal issues relating to motherhood and maternity benefits.

#LegalVidhya #LawStudent #LegalEducation #MaternityBenefits #LegalStudies #LearningExperience
comment: A key challenge ahead is ensuring maternity benefit frameworks evolve with diverse paths to parenthood while maintaining clarity for employers on eligibility, documentation, and implementation.
